fee_waiver.value: Graduate School fee waivers are limited and mainly for applicants who completed certain career and professional preparatory programs; the FreeApp waiver is for domestic students only. Request a waiver at least three weeks before your program's deadline and before submitting.
fee_waiver.quote: The University of Maryland Graduate School's application fee waiver program helps applicants who have completed certain career and professional preparatory programs by reducing their application costs. | Please note: Fee waivers are limited and considered individually.

also.quote: The FreeApp is designed to increase access to graduate education for domestic students.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule; each program decides (see the program records).

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 96 total (Reading 26, Listening 24, Speaking 22, Writing 24) for full enrollment on tests taken by January 20, 2026, or 5 overall on the new 1-6 scale for later tests. Lower scores (88-95, or 4.5 new scale) can mean admission with a required Maryland English Institute course; some programs refuse that.
toefl_min.quote: iBT TOEFL (taken January 20, 2026 or before) Requirements for Full Enrollment | Total 96 96 88-95 87 and below* | iBT TOEFL (taken January 21, 2026 or after) Requirements for Full Enrollment | Overall 5 5 4.5 0-4

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Speaking 6.5, other sections 7) for full enrollment; 6.5 can mean admission with a required English bridge course.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Requirements for Full Enrollment | Overall 7 7 6.5 6.0 and below*

english_waiver.value: Only degrees from the US or the listed English-speaking countries exempt you; India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a TOEFL, IELTS or PTE score.
english_waiver.quote: Students who have received a degree from a regionally accredited institution in the U.S. or a nationally recognized university in one of the countries on the subsequent list do not need to submit TOEFL, IELTS or PTE scores

notes: PTE Academic (68) also accepted. Individual programs may set stricter English rules; Spring 2027 Intensive English is not offered.
